instruction.text: Sort the Earth, Sun and Moon by diameter, with the biggest at the top.

atoms.b: The bigger the object, the ((++stronger weaker)) its gravitational force. Bigger objects will pull ((++smaller even_bigger)) objects into their orbit.

This is why the Earth’s gravity keeps the ((++Moon Sun)) in its orbit, while the Sun’s ((++gravity light)) holds the Earth in its orbit — along with all the other planets in the solar ((++system structure))!
